verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item documents Namecheap's published per-TLD registration/renewal/transfer pricing or any transparency policy; the closest community remark (namecheap-comm-9) merely warns that renewal pricing is not discounted, which is anecdotal and doesn't confirm a transparent published price list. missing for 10: a first-party pricing page or TLD price list, explicit renewal/transfer pricing disclosure, and independent verification that no teaser pricing hides a renewal spike.
